No character, hand, floor or large exposed torch flame.

Sixteen light-only frames of a compact shielded amber volume with a small white-gold center, lower-weighted illumination, subtle glass-cylinder structure, organic dusty irregularity and restrained breathing. Keep one shared luminous core and no lamp object or exposed flame.

Sixteen light-only short asymmetric warm reflector beams sharing one root, spreading forward and slightly downward with glass-rib shadows and dust breakup. Keep physically plausible soft edges and avoid perfect spotlight wedges, objects, flame and broad halos.

Sixteen light-only broad irregular amber-gold penumbra fields with a restrained bright center, softly darkened vertical cage-rib shadows, lower-half weight, gentle edge breakup and stable protected-lamp variation.
Sixteen light-only floor and near-wall bounce fields, low and broad, strongest below a shared lamp source, with subtle side-wall return and dusty reflected softness but no depicted surface geometry.
Sixteen compact glass-filtered hot-core frames with a tiny white-yellow vertical wick core, warm amber glass glow, narrow caustics, cage-rib interruptions and a compact asymmetric bloom.

Sixteen sparse light-only atmosphere frames with warm dust motes, faint short glass-caustic threads, a little soot haze above the shared source and a few downward-lit particles. Keep the field delicate and restrained without torch sparks.
